November 16, 2026


Our 2026 Community Tour took us to Pinehouse last week, where we connected with community members, shared Collaboration Agreement updates and welcomed more than 80 students to an afternoon workshop covering reclamation, exploration, career opportunities and more. We also had the chance to cheer on the Pinehouse Lakers football team during their playoff win, enjoy a delicious community meal and reconnect with friends old and new. Thanks for the warm welcome and we look forward to next time! #Pinehouse #NorthernSaskatchewan #CommunityPartnerships[#CommunityTour](https://facebook.com/hashtag/CommunityTour)
